request_summary.prompt_prefix: Write a professional summary about the candidate.  CANDIDATE SKILL AREAS: Kubernetes and Terraform, Observability, Incident Response, Languages  CANDIDATE ACHIE

response: {"summary":"9+ years of experience in Kubernetes and Terraform, observability, and incident response, owning the Kubernetes platform powering all payment services and authoring the Terraform modules used company-wide. Reduced mean time to recovery from 45 to 11 minutes on a payments system, cut alert noise by 70 percent through rewritten Prometheus alerting, and led incident response efforts—including establishing the on-call rotation, automating certificate rotation, and writing the runbooks still used by the support team."}
